sanskrit: एतत् श्रुत्वा कूर्मः अवदत्- मित्रे! किं युवाभ्यां धीवराणां वार्ता श्रुता?

reviewer_translation: The two swans said: 'Whatever is appropriate should be done in the morning.'
reference_english: The two swans said: 'Whatever is appropriate should be done in the morning.'

sanskrit: कृष्णमूर्तिः श्रीकण्ठश्च मित्रे आस्ताम्।

reference_english: Shrikantha's father was prosperous.

sanskrit: अतः तस्य भवने सर्वविधानि सुखसाधनानि आसन्।
student_translation: Therefore in his mansion all types of luxury facilities were present.
reviewer_translation: Hence, all kinds of comfortable amenities were in his mansion.
reference_english: Hence, all kinds of comfortable amenities were in his mansion.

sanskrit: तस्मिन् विशाले भवने चत्वारिंशत् स्तम्भाः आसन्।
student_translation: In that huge building were forty pillars.
reviewer_translation: In that grand house, there were forty pillars.
reference_english: In that grand house, there were forty pillars.

sanskrit: परं कृष्णमूर्तेः माता पिता च निर्धनौ कृषकदम्पती।

reference_english: However, Krishnamurti's parents were a poor farmer couple.

student_translation: His house was without luxury and simple.
reviewer_translation: His home was devoid of ostentation and simple.
reference_english: His home was devoid of ostentation and simple.

sanskrit: केचन बालकाः काश्चन बालिकाश्च स्वतन्त्रतादिवसस्य ध्वजारोहणसमारोहे सोत्साहं गच्छन्ति।
student_translation: Some boys and some girls go enthusiastically to the flag-hoisting ceremony of Independence Day.

reference_english: Some boys and girls are going enthusiastically to the flag-hoisting ceremony of Independence Day.

reference_english: Today is Independence Day.

sanskrit: सः कदाचित् इतस्ततः परिभ्रमन् क्षुधार्तः न किञ्चिदपि आहारं प्राप्तवान्।

student_translation: In the meantime, the master of the cave, a jackal named Dadhipuccha, arrived.

chapter_title: बिलस्य वाणी न कदापि मे श्रुता
sanskrit: सः च यावत् पश्यति तावत् सिंहपदपद्धतिः गुहायां प्रविष्टा दृश्यते।
student_translation: And as far as he looks, so far the trail of lion footprints is seen entered in the cave.

reference_english: And as far as he looked, he saw the lion's paw prints going into the cave.

reference_english: And not coming back out.

sanskrit: शृगालः अचिन्तयत्- अहो विनष्टोऽस्मि!
student_translation: The jackal thought: Oh I am destroyed!
reviewer_translation: The jackal thought: 'Alas, I am ruined!'
reference_english: The jackal thought: 'Alas, I am ruined!'

chapter_title: बिलस्य वाणी न कदापि मे श्रुता
sanskrit: नूनम् अस्मिन् बिले सिंहः अस्ति इति तर्कयामि।
student_translation: Surely in this cave a lion is there, so I reason.

reviewer_translation: Then what should I do?

sanskrit: अद्य सम्पूर्णविश्वे 'डिजिटल इण्डिया' इत्यस्य चर्चा श्रूयते।

reviewer_translation: Today, discussions about 'Digital India' are heard all over the world.
reference_english: Today, discussions about 'Digital India' are heard all over the world.

sanskrit: अस्य पदस्य कः भावः इति मनसि जिज्ञासा उत्पद्यते।
student_translation: What is the meaning of this word, such curiosity arises in the mind.

reference_english: Curiosity arises in the mind as to what the meaning of this term is.

sanskrit: कालपरिवर्तनेन सह मानवस्य आवश्यकता अपि परिवर्तते।

student_translation: In subsequent time, by the invention of paper and pen, writing of all inner thoughts upon paper began.

reference_english: Through her own efforts, she made a monumental contribution in women's education.

student_translation: The sun is motionless and the earth is moving which rotates on its own axis, is now a well-established principle.

student_translation: By him it was propounded that in eclipses demons named Rahu and Ketu are not the cause.
reviewer_translation: He established that the demons Rahu and Ketu are not the cause of eclipses.
reference_english: He established that the demons Rahu and Ketu are not the cause of eclipses.

sanskrit: अयि वाणि! नवीनां वीणाम् अयि वादय।
student_translation: O Saraswati! Play a new lute.
reviewer_translation: O Goddess of speech, play a new veena.
reference_english: O Goddess of speech, play a new veena.

sanskrit: ललितनीतिलीनां मधुरं गीतिं गाय।
student_translation: Sing a sweet song immersed in graceful virtues.
reviewer_translation: Sing a melodious hymn rich with graceful principles.
reference_english: Sing a melodious hymn rich with graceful principles.

sanskrit: पुरा कस्मिंश्चित् ग्रामे एका निर्धना वृद्धा स्त्री न्यवसत्।
student_translation: In ancient times in a certain village lived an elderly poor woman.
reviewer_translation: In ancient times, an impoverished elderly woman lived in a certain village.
reference_english: In ancient times, an impoverished elderly woman lived in a certain village.

sanskrit: तस्याश्च एका दुहिता विम्रा मनोहरा च आसीत्।
student_translation: And she had a daughter, humble and charming.
reviewer_translation: And she had a daughter who was gentle and charming.
reference_english: And she had a daughter who was gentle and charming.

sanskrit: एकदा माता स्थाल्यां तण्डुलान् निक्षिप्य पुत्रीम् आदिशत्।
student_translation: Once the mother, placing rice grains in a plate, instructed her daughter.
reviewer_translation: Once the mother, placing grains of rice in a plate, instructed her daughter.
reference_english: Once the mother, placing grains of rice in a plate, instructed her daughter.

sanskrit: सूर्यातपे तण्डुलान् खगेभ्यो रक्ष।
student_translation: In the sunlight protect the rice grains from birds.
reviewer_translation: Protect the rice grains from birds in the sunshine.
reference_english: Protect the rice grains from birds in the sunshine.

sanskrit: किञ्चित्कालादनन्तरम् एको विचित्रः काकः समुड्डीय तस्याः समीपम् अगच्छत्।
student_translation: After some time a strange crow flying arrived near her.
reviewer_translation: After some time, an extraordinary crow flew up and approached her.
reference_english: After some time, an extraordinary crow flew up and approached her.

sanskrit: नैतादृशः स्वर्णपक्षो रजतचञ्चुः स्वर्णकाकस्तया पूर्वं दृष्टः।
student_translation: Never before was such a golden crow with golden wings and silver beak seen by her.
reviewer_translation: Such a golden crow with silver beak and golden wings had never been seen by her before.
reference_english: Such a golden crow with silver beak and golden wings had never been seen by her before.

sanskrit: तं तण्डुलान् खादन्तं हसन्तञ्च विलोक्य बालिका रोदितुम् आरब्धा।
student_translation: Seeing him eating rice and laughing, the girl began to weep.
reviewer_translation: Beholding him eating the grains and laughing, the girl began to cry.
reference_english: Beholding him eating the grains and laughing, the girl began to cry.

sanskrit: तं निवारयन्ती सा प्रार्थयत्- तण्डुलान् मा भक्षय।
student_translation: Stopping him she prayed: Do not eat the rice.
reviewer_translation: Dissuading him, she pleaded: 'Please do not eat the rice grains.'
reference_english: Dissuading him, she pleaded: 'Please do not eat the rice grains.'

sanskrit: मदीया माता अतीव निर्धना वर्तते।
student_translation: My mother is extremely poor.
reviewer_translation: My mother is extremely impoverished.
reference_english: My mother is extremely impoverished.

sanskrit: काकः प्रोवाच- मा शुचः।
student_translation: The crow said: Do not grieve.
reviewer_translation: The crow replied: 'Do not despair.'
reference_english: The crow replied: 'Do not despair.'

sanskrit: सूर्योदयात् प्राग् ग्रामाद् बहिः पिप्पलवृक्षमनु त्वया आगन्तव्यम्।
student_translation: Before sunrise, you must come near the peepal tree outside the village.
reviewer_translation: You should come to the peepal tree outside the village before sunrise.
reference_english: You should come to the peepal tree outside the village before sunrise.

sanskrit: अहं तुभ्यं तण्डुलमूल्यं दास्यामि।
student_translation: I will give you the price of rice.
reviewer_translation: I will give you the value of the grains.
reference_english: I will give you the value of the grains.

sanskrit: मल्लिका अपूपानि रचयन्ती मन्दस्वरेण शिवस्तुतिं करोति।
student_translation: Mallika while preparing sweets does praise of Shiva in a low voice.
reviewer_translation: Mallika sings a hymn to Shiva in a low voice while preparing sweet cakes.
reference_english: Mallika sings a hymn to Shiva in a low voice while preparing sweet cakes.

sanskrit: ततः प्रविशति मोदकगन्धम् अनुभवन् प्रसन्नमनाः चन्दनः।
student_translation: Then enters Chandana, happy-minded, experiencing the aroma of laddoos.
reviewer_translation: Then enters Chandana, his heart delighted as he smells the aroma of sweets.
reference_english: Then enters Chandana, his heart delighted as he smells the aroma of sweets.

sanskrit: चन्दनः- अहा! सुगन्धस्तु मनोहरः।
student_translation: Chandana- Aha! The fragrance indeed is captivating.
reviewer_translation: Chandana: 'Aha! The pleasant aroma is indeed captivating.'
reference_english: Chandana: 'Aha! The pleasant aroma is indeed captivating.'

sanskrit: विलोक्य- अये मोदकानि रच्यन्ते?
student_translation: Looking- Oh, sweets are being prepared?
reviewer_translation: Looking around: 'Oh, sweets are being prepared?'
reference_english: Looking around: 'Oh, sweets are being prepared?'

sanskrit: भोः! किमर्थम् इदं सिकताभिः सेतुनिर्माणं करोषि?
student_translation: O! Why are you doing bridge construction with sand?
reviewer_translation: Hey! Why are you building a bridge with sand?
reference_english: Hey! Why are you building a bridge with sand?

sanskrit: व्यर्थः अयम् आयासः।
student_translation: This effort is futile.
reviewer_translation: This exertion of yours is useless.
reference_english: This exertion of yours is useless.

sanskrit: तीव्रप्रवाहे नद्याः सिकताः किं स्थास्यन्ति?
student_translation: Will the sand stay in the swift current of the river?
reviewer_translation: Will grains of sand remain stable in the river's swift current?
reference_english: Will grains of sand remain stable in the river's swift current?

sanskrit: पुरुषः- पश्य! चिन्तितं मया नात्र काचिद् विफलता।
student_translation: The man- Look! Considered by me, there is no failure here.
reviewer_translation: The man: 'Look! I have reflected, and I see no failure here.'
reference_english: The man: 'Look! I have reflected, and I see no failure here.'

sanskrit: यथा त्वं लिपिज्ञानं विना केवलं तपसा विद्याम् अवाप्तुम् इच्छसि तथैव अहमपि सेतुं निर्मास्यामि।
student_translation: Just as you without script knowledge want to attain learning only by penance, similarly I also will construct a bridge.
reviewer_translation: Just as you wish to master learning through penance without knowledge of script, I too shall build this bridge.
reference_english: Just as you wish to master learning through penance without knowledge of script, I too shall build this bridge.

sanskrit: प्रकृतिः समेषां प्राणिनां संरक्षणाय यतते।
student_translation: Nature strives for the protection of all living beings.
reviewer_translation: Nature strives to protect all living beings.
reference_english: Nature strives to protect all living beings.

sanskrit: इयं सर्वान् पुष्णाति विविधैः प्रकारैः सुखसाधनैश्च तर्पयति।
student_translation: She nourishes all and gratifies with various manners and comforts.
reviewer_translation: She nourishes everyone and gratifies them in various ways through comforts.
reference_english: She nourishes everyone and gratifies them in various ways through comforts.

sanskrit: दुर्बहम् अत्र जीवितं जातं प्रकृतिरेव शरणम्।
student_translation: Life here has become difficult to endure, nature alone is our refuge.
reviewer_translation: Living here has become unbearable; nature alone is our refuge.
reference_english: Living here has become unbearable; nature alone is our refuge.

sanskrit: महानगरमध्ये चलदनिशं कालायसचक्रम्।
student_translation: In the middle of metropolises moving day and night is the iron wheel.
reviewer_translation: In the midst of large cities, the iron wheel turns day and night.
reference_english: In the midst of large cities, the iron wheel turns day and night.

sanskrit: अस्ति देउलाख्यो ग्रामः।
student_translation: There is a village named Deula.
reviewer_translation: There was a village named Deulakhya.
reference_english: There was a village named Deulakhya.

sanskrit: तत्र राजसिंहः नाम राजपुत्रः वसति स्म।
student_translation: There lived a king's son named Rajasimha.
reviewer_translation: A prince named Rajasimha lived there.
reference_english: A prince named Rajasimha lived there.

sanskrit: एकदा केनापि कार्येण तस्य भार्या बुद्धिमती पुत्रद्वयोपेता पितुर्गृहं प्रति चलिता।
student_translation: Once for some task his wife Buddhimati accompanied by two sons set out towards her father's house.
reviewer_translation: Once on some urgent matter, his wife Buddhimati set out for her father's house accompanied by her two sons.
reference_english: Once on some urgent matter, his wife Buddhimati set out for her father's house accompanied by her two sons.

sanskrit: मार्गे गहनकानने सा एकं व्याघ्रं ददर्श।
student_translation: On the path in a dense forest she saw a tiger.
reviewer_translation: On the road through a dense forest, she saw a tiger.
reference_english: On the road through a dense forest, she saw a tiger.

sanskrit: सा व्याघ्रम् आगच्छन्तं दृष्ट्वा धाष्ट्र्‌यात् पुत्रौ चपेटया प्रहृत्य जगाद।
student_translation: She, seeing the tiger coming, audaciously striking her sons with a slap said.
reviewer_translation: Seeing the tiger approaching, she boldly slapped her two sons and said.
reference_english: Seeing the tiger approaching, she boldly slapped her two sons and said.

sanskrit: कथम् एकैकशो व्याघ्रभक्षणाय कलहं कुरुथः?
student_translation: Why do you quarrel to eat one tiger separately?
reviewer_translation: Why do you both quarrel over eating one single tiger?
reference_english: Why do you both quarrel over eating one single tiger?

sanskrit: अयम् एकस्तावद् विभज्य भुज्यताम्।
student_translation: This is one, therefore dividing let it be eaten.
reviewer_translation: Let this one be divided and eaten between you for now.
reference_english: Let this one be divided and eaten between you for now.

sanskrit: पश्चाद् अन्यो द्वितीयः कश्चिल्लक्ष्यते।
student_translation: Later some other second one will be looked for.
reviewer_translation: Later, some second tiger may be located.
reference_english: Later, some second tiger may be located.

sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा व्याघ्रमारी काचिदियम् इति मत्वा व्याघ्रो भयाकुलचित्तो नष्टः।
student_translation: Hearing this, thinking this is some tiger-killer, the tiger fled with frightened heart.
reviewer_translation: Hearing this, fearing that she was some tiger-slayer, the tiger fled in panic.
reference_english: Hearing this, fearing that she was some tiger-slayer, the tiger fled in panic.

sanskrit: शरीरायासजननं कर्म व्यायामसंज्ञितम्।
student_translation: Action producing bodily effort is termed exercise.
reviewer_translation: Physical activity producing bodily exertion is designated as exercise.
reference_english: Physical activity producing bodily exertion is designated as exercise.

sanskrit: तत् कृत्वा तु सुखं देहं विमृद्नीयात् समन्ततः।
student_translation: Doing that indeed, one should massage the body pleasantly all over.
reviewer_translation: Having performed it, one should massage the body thoroughly and comfortably.
reference_english: Having performed it, one should massage the body thoroughly and comfortably.

sanskrit: कश्चित् कृषकः बलीवर्दाभ्यां क्षेत्रकर्षणं कुर्वन्नासीत्।
student_translation: A certain farmer was ploughing the field with two oxen.
reviewer_translation: A certain farmer was ploughing his field with a pair of bullocks.
reference_english: A certain farmer was ploughing his field with a pair of bullocks.

sanskrit: तयोः बलीवर्दयोः एकः शरीरेण दुर्बलः जवेन गन्तुम् अशक्तश्चासीत्।
student_translation: Of those two bullocks, one was weak in body and unable to walk swiftly.
reviewer_translation: Of the two oxen, one was physically frail and incapable of walking fast.
reference_english: Of the two oxen, one was physically frail and incapable of walking fast.

sanskrit: अतः कृषकः तं दुर्बलं वृषभं तोदनेन नुद्यमानः अवर्तत।
student_translation: Therefore the farmer continued prodding that weak bull with pain.
reviewer_translation: Hence, the farmer kept driving the frail bull forward with torment.
reference_english: Hence, the farmer kept driving the frail bull forward with torment.

sanskrit: सः वृषभः हलम् ऊढ्वा गन्तुम् अशक्तः क्षेत्रे पपात।
student_translation: That bull, incapable of going carrying the plough, fell in the field.
reviewer_translation: Unable to move bearing the plough, the bull collapsed in the field.
reference_english: Unable to move bearing the plough, the bull collapsed in the field.

sanskrit: क्रुद्धः कृषीवलः तमुत्थापयितुं बहुवारं यत्नम् अकरोत्।
student_translation: The angry farmer tried many times to lift him up.
reviewer_translation: The enraged farmer made numerous attempts to raise him up.
reference_english: The enraged farmer made numerous attempts to raise him up.

sanskrit: तथापि वृषः नोत्थितः।
student_translation: Even then the bull did not rise.
reviewer_translation: Even so, the bull did not stand up.
reference_english: Even so, the bull did not stand up.

sanskrit: भूमौ पतिते स्वपुत्रे दृष्ट्वा सर्वधेनूनां मातुः सुरभेः नेत्राभ्याम् अश्रूणि आविरासन्।
student_translation: Seeing her son fallen on the ground, tears appeared from the eyes of Surabhi, mother of all cows.
reviewer_translation: Seeing her son fallen upon the ground, tears welled up from the eyes of Surabhi, the mother of all cattle.
reference_english: Seeing her son fallen upon the ground, tears welled up from the eyes of Surabhi, the mother of all cattle.
